answer: Require every agent to lock a refundable stake in a vault before it can earn: creating one identity is cheap, but a plume of thousands of fake identities would need thousands of separate stakes, each frozen for weeks and slashed if the identity cheats. Like a crystal that only forms under sustained pressure, reputation then grows slowly from verified work, so an attacker must pay real capital and time per fake, while honest agents keep their stake and build trust.
